hero.title: GhostGPT: your AI that remembers you. Decentralized intelligence for real operators.
hero.subtitle: Local Cognitive System turns agent workflows into something teams can inspect, approve, and trust under pressure.

problem.title: From fragile AI to persistent intelligence

items.centralized: Centralized AI limits ownership, traceability, and trust.
items.size: Larger models still lose context at the exact moment operators need clarity.
items.hallucinations: Hallucinations break mission-critical reviews and incident response.
items.memory: Most assistants forget your history, decisions, and prior approvals.

problem.solutionBody: Architecture beats raw model size. Causal memory, human approvals, and replayable traces make agent behavior explainable and resilient.

local.title: Local-first
local.desc: Operational data stays under your control instead of disappearing into a hosted black box.

causal.title: Causal Memory
causal.desc: Remembers what happened, why it happened, and what changed after review.

human.title: Human-Centric Design
human.desc: Approval loops keep human intent attached to every important task transition.

anti.title: Anti-Hallucination
anti.desc: Traceable reasoning makes suspicious behavior visible before approval.

identity.title: Evolving Identity
identity.desc: The system adapts to operator feedback instead of resetting every session.

cta.title: Bring explainable agent operations into your stack

runtime.title: An operating system for AI behavior control

problem.title: Problem
problem.body: AI decisions are opaque. Teams struggle to explain, verify, and correct agent behavior once a workflow is already moving.

solution.title: Solution
solution.body: Reflection Runtime adds a control loop: reflection -> review -> approve or reject -> behavior update.

runtimeLive.title: Runtime Live Panel
runtimeLive.offlineNote: Local demo data is shown because the reflection backend is offline. The panel remains interactive so the operator flow stays visible on a static landing.
